Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced a misleading birth year for Kim Dae-hwan by surfacing an AsianWiki snippet showing “Born: 1933,” conflating the End of Winter director with a different person of the same name. This identity mix-up (later echoed by a 1976 footballer result) would mislead the age comparison, whereas the correct director (Kim Dae-hwan, born 1985) makes Paweł Pawlikowski (1957) the older director.
